actions.name: Block
actions.sourceText: Each time Sergeant Gideon rolls a skull while defending, the attack misses.

actions.name: Defensive Stance
actions.sourceText: Each time 1 of your defending Space Marines spends a Support Token to reroll a die, the attack misses unless the new roll is a 0.

actions.name: Counter Attack
actions.sourceText: Each time Sergeant Lorenzo rolls a skull while defending, the attack misses and slay 1 of the attacking Genestealers. If the swarm still contains a Genestealer, it attacks again.

actions.name: Overwatch
actions.sourceText: At the end of the Event Phase, each of your Space Marines may spend 1 Support Token to make 1 attack.

actions.name: Strategize
actions.sourceText: After resolving this card's action, you may move 1 swarm to an adjacent position and/or move it to the other side of the formation.

actions.name: Power Field
actions.sourceText: After resolving this card's action, you may choose any swarm. Genestealers in the chosen swarm may not attack or be slain this round.

actions.name: Onward Brothers!
actions.sourceText: Each time 1 of your Space Marines activates a Door, you may place 1 additional Support Token on the Terrain card.

actions.name: Stealth Tactics
actions.sourceText: After resolving this card's action, you may discard 1 card from either blip pile. You may then spend 1 Support Token to discard 1 card from the other blip pile.

actions.name: Reorganize
actions.sourceText: Your Space Marines may move to any position in the formation (instead of just to adjacent positions).

actions.name: Forward Scouting
actions.sourceText: After resolving this card's action, you may look at the top card of the Event deck. Then place it on the top or bottom of the deck.

actions.name: Intimidation
actions.sourceText: After resolving this card's action, you may roll a die. Shuffle that many Genestealer cards (of your choice) engaged with your Space Marines into the smallest blip pile.

actions.name: Run and Gun
actions.sourceText: After resolving this card's action, each of your Space Marines may spend 1 Support Token to make 1 attack.

actions.name: Lead By Example
actions.sourceText: When 1 of your Space Marines slays a Genestealer, you may place 1 Support Token on any Space Marine (limit once per round).

actions.name: Flamer Attack
actions.sourceText: When Brother Zael attacks, ignore all skulls rolled. Instead, slay a number of Genestealers in the swarm equal to the number rolled.

actions.name: Psionic Attack
actions.sourceText: Each time Lexicanium Calistarius rolls a skull while attacking, he may immediately make 1 additional attack.

actions.name: Dead Aim
actions.sourceText: Each time 1 of your attacking Space Marines rolls a 4, slay up to 3 Genestealers from the defending swarm.

actions.name: Full Auto
actions.sourceText: Brother Leon may attack up to 3 times (instead of just once).

actions.name: Heroic Charge
actions.sourceText: Instead of attacking with Brother Claudio, you may slay up to 3 Genestealers within 1 range of him (ignoring facing). Then roll a die. If you roll a 0, Brother Claudio is slain.

events.name: Surrounded
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine. Move all Genestealers (from every position) to the chosen Space Marine's position (do not change their side).

events.name: Flanking Manoeuvre
events.sourceText: Move all swarms so that they are behind their engaged Space Marine.

events.name: Out of Thin Air
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine. Spawn 2 Genestealers behind him.

events.name: Out of Thin Air
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine. Spawn 2 Genestealers behind him.

events.name: The Swarm
events.sourceText: Place 2 Genestealer cards into each blip pile (from the Genestealer deck).

events.name: The Swarm
events.sourceText: Place 2 Genestealer cards into each blip pile (from the Genestealer deck).

events.name: Psychic Assault
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine and roll a die. If you roll a 0 or 1, the Space Marine is slain.

events.name: They're Everywhere!
events.sourceText: Spawn 1 Genestealer in front of each Space Marine that is not engaged with a swarm.

events.name: Evasion
events.sourceText: When a player resolves an Attack Action card next round, he may only attack with 1 Space Marine of that Combat Team (instead of both).

events.name: Outnumbered
events.sourceText: Discard all Support Tokens from each Space Marine that is engaged with at least 1 swarm.

events.name: Chaos of Battle
events.sourceText: Change every Space Marine's facing.

events.name: Stalking from the Shadows
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine with at least 1 Support Token. Discard all his Support Tokens.

events.name: Resupply
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine. Move all Support Tokens to him from all other Space Marines.

events.name: Gun Jam
events.sourceText: Choose a Combat Team that did not reveal an Attack Action this round. Next round, that Combat Team may not play an Attack Action card.

events.name: For My Battle Brothers!
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine that has at least 1 Support Token (if able). Discard 1 Support Token from him and 1 Genestealer engaged with him (of your choice).

events.name: Rewarded Faith
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine. You may discard any number of Support Tokens from him to slay an equal number of Genestealers engaged with him.

events.name: Full Scan
events.sourceText: Choose a blip pile. Discard the top card of the chosen pile.

events.name: Cleansing Flames
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine and roll a die. If you roll a skull, slay 2 Genestealers engaged with him (of your choice).

events.name: Second Wind
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine. Each time he rolls a 0 while defending next round, the attack misses.

events.name: Quick Instincts
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine. He may immediately make 1 attack.

events.name: Secret Route
events.sourceText: If there is a Door Terrain card in the formation, place 2 Support Tokens on it.

events.name: Enter Formation
events.sourceText: Each time a player resolves a Move + Activate Action card next round, he may first place 1 Support Token on any Space Marine.

events.name: Temporary Sanctuary
events.sourceText: Choose a swarm of Genestealers. Shuffle all cards from the chosen swarm into the smallest blip pile.

events.name: Rescue Space Marine
events.sourceText: Choose a Space Marine that has been slain belonging to a non-eliminated Combat Team. Place the Space Marine card at the bottom of the formation facing the right.

terrain.name: Artefact
terrain.sourceText: Place this card in your hand. You may discard this card after 1 of your Space Marines rolls the die while defending to make the attack miss.

terrain.name: Control Panel
terrain.sourceText: Use the current Location card's 'Activate Control Panel' ability.

terrain.name: Door
terrain.sourceText: Place 1 Support token on this card. When travelling, the current player may first slay 1 Genestealer in the formation for each Support token on this card.

terrain.name: Promethium Tank
terrain.sourceText: Discard this Terrain card and slay all Genestealers on this position. Then roll a die. If you roll a 0, slay this Space Marine.

terrain.name: Spore Chimney
terrain.sourceText: Roll a die. If you roll a skull, discard this Terrain card.

locations.name: Main Corridor
locations.sourceText: Spawn 2 Genestealers on the 'Corridor' Terrain card.

locations.name: Maintenance Tunnels
locations.sourceText: Discard the 'Control Panel' Terrain card, and replace it with a 'Corridor' Terrain card.

locations.name: Service Shaft
locations.sourceText: Make each Space Marine face the right side of the formation.

locations.name: Lower Accessway
locations.sourceText: Spawn 2 Genestealers behind the Space Marine at the top of the formation.

locations.name: Hibernation Cluster
locations.sourceText: For each Space Marine in the formation, place 1 Genestealer card into each blip pile from the Genestealer deck.

locations.name: Munitorium
locations.sourceText: The current player places 1 Support Token each on any 2 Space Marines.

locations.name: Cryo Control
locations.sourceText: Discard 1 card from the blip pile of your choice.

locations.name: Wrath of Baal Chapel
locations.sourceText: The current player places the 'Artefact' Terrain card on any position and side of the formation.

locations.name: Apothecarion
locations.sourceText: Place 1 Support Token on any Space Marine. You may then change that Space Marine's facing.

locations.name: Dark Catacombs
locations.sourceText: The current player must choose a Space Marine with 0 Support Tokens (if able). Spawn 1 Genestealer behind a chosen Space Marine.

locations.name: Teleportarium
locations.sourceText: Each Space Marine must discard 1 Support Token or roll a die. On a 0, the Space Marine is slain. Then, regardless of the die rolls, discard all cards from both blip piles.

locations.name: Black Holds
locations.sourceText: The current player chooses a swarm (if able), and spawns 2 Genestealers on it. If 0 swarms are in the formation, this has no effect.

locations.name: Wreckage Labyrinth
locations.sourceText: Change the facing of each Space Marine who is facing a Terrain card in his position.

locations.name: Core Cogitator
locations.sourceText: Choose a Terrain card. A maximum of 1 Genestealer may spawn on that Terrain card during the next Event Phase.

locations.name: Genetorium
locations.sourceText: Roll a die. If you roll a skull, slay up to 4 Genestealers of your choice (in any positions), otherwise slay this Space Marine.

locations.name: Genestealer Lair
locations.sourceText: Move all swarms to the red Terrain card on their side of the formation. Then spawn 1 Brood Lord on each red Terrain card. If both Brood Lords are slain, Space Marines win.

locations.name: Launch Control Room
locations.sourceText: Place a Support Token on this card or roll a die. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of Support Tokens on this card, Space Marines win. Otherwise there is no effect.

locations.name: Toxin Pumping Station
locations.sourceText: Roll a die and discard that many cards from the blip pile of your choice. Space Marines may only win when there are 0 cards in both blip piles and 0 Genestealer cards in the formation.

broodLords.name: Brood Lord A
broodLords.sourceText: Never shuffled into Genestealer deck/blips; only spawned by Location. Swarm moves when either icon activates. Cannot be slain while a normal Genestealer would remain in its swarm. Subtract 1 from swarm's defense die roll when it attacks.

broodLords.name: Brood Lord B
broodLords.sourceText: Never shuffled into Genestealer deck/blips; only spawned by Location. Swarm moves when either icon activates. Cannot be slain while a normal Genestealer would remain in its swarm. Subtract 1 from swarm's defense die roll when it attacks.
